answer: This protocol resists Sybils with a per-identity staked bond, not fake diversity. Every agent locks a refundable stake slashed when its answers fail grading, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand simultaneous bonds. An honest agent can wander across epochs with one modest stake, but a farm must hold that on every puppet at once. Attacker capital scales linearly with identity count, and one failed audit burns the stake, pushing mass creation above its reward. Like a juniper anchoring dry soil, the bond holds trust fixed; when the tide of cheap accounts rises, stake keeps each accountable.
